title: Tensor right Cech exactness
statement: Let k be a field, X and Y schemes over Spec k with affine relative diagonals, U and V finite indexed families of affine opens of X and Y, F a quasi-coherent module on X, and S a short exact sequence of quasi-coherent modules on Y. Then S.map(picardRightTensorCechFunctor f g U V F) of [def-sc-picard-external-right-cech-models] is short exact. No cover condition is required.

source.place: Tag 0BED, coefficient diagram following equation-kunneth-on-cech, right-variable version; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BED read by second reader

proof.text: Use the affine relative diagonal criterion and induction on the positive tuple length to show that every right Cech intersection is affine. Identify the categorical product of opens with the infimum.

Forget the module action to get a short exact sequence of abelian sheaves. The quasi-coherent kernel is Cech-acyclic on affine opens by exactAt_cechComplex_basicOpen. Apply the proved wrapper surjective_app_of_cechAcyclicOnAffines for the topological Cech lifting criterion. Sections are injective and exact at the middle.

Scalar restriction retains these section functions. In each Cech degree, use product projections and ModuleCat.piIsoPi to assemble the coordinate lifts and prove injectivity, epicity, and middle exactness. The map-projection compatibility and degreewise criterion prove scalar Cech short exactness. The proof is the private picard_right_cech_sections_exact helper in the item module.

Apply the tensor bifunctor to the fixed left cochains and the scalar Cech short exact sequence. Evaluating the bicomplex twice gives tensorLeft on a short exact vector-space sequence. Every field module is flat, and Mathlib.RingTheory.Flat.CategoryTheory supplies finite-limit preservation, so ShortExact.map_of_exact applies. Degreewise detection twice proves bicomplex short exactness.

Apply shortExact_extended_total to this bicomplex sequence. The bifunctor sends the identity in the fixed left argument to the identity; normalizing functor maps identifies the totalized and extended maps with those of picardRightTensorCechFunctor. The private tensor-total helpers implement this step. Finally apply tensor preservation to the scalar Cech exactness proved above.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0BED, right-variable coefficient diagram; proved directly in the item module using closed affine Cech lifting machinery, Mathlib field flatness, and the proved first-quadrant extended-total exactness theorem.

mathlib_searches.query: Short exact sequences preserved by Cech sections on affine opens and tensor total complexes over a field
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits, principally MayerVietorisSquare.shortComplex_shortExact and affine transition-limit section lemmas; no fixed coefficient Cech functor exactness theorem.
Twelve generic hits: ShortExact, Splitting.shortExact, shortExact_of_iso, shortExact_iff_of_iso, splittingOfInjective and op/unop lemmas. None establishes the required coefficient section exactness.
mathlib_searches.verdict: No matching fixed right Cech theorem.

mathlib_searches.query: shortExact_cechComplex; shortExact_iff_degreewise_shortExact; shortExact in PicardExternalCupLeftCechExact, TotalComplex and Bifunctor
mathlib_searches.results: TopCat.Sheaf.shortExact_cechComplex requires sectionwise surjectivity for abelian sheaves. HomologicalComplex.shortExact_iff_degreewise_shortExact supplies the final generic step. The left coefficient theorem is still sorry and fixes finite subcovers, unlike these arbitrary finite families. TotalComplex and Bifunctor do not give the needed affine coefficient result.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Generic final tools found; no duplicate component statement.

mathlib_searches.query: The Cech complex of quasi coherent modules on affine intersections sends a short exact sequence to a degreewise short exact sequence

from.place: Tensor conjunct of the short exact coefficient diagram

lean.statement:
theorem picardExternal_right_cech_tensor_exact
    {k : Type w} [Field k] {X Y : Scheme.{w}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal f)] [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal g)]
    {ι κ : Type w} [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : κ → Y.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (U i)) (hV : ∀ j, IsAffineOpen (V j))
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (S : ShortComplex Y.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    [S.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [S.X₂.IsQuasicoherent] [S.X₃.IsQuasicoherent] :
    (S.map (picardRightTensorCechFunctor f g U V F)).ShortExact
